messages:
Maya: kicking off staged rollout v2026.03.23-rc6 -> 10% global, regions=[na-west, eu-central]. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.03.23-rc6
DeployBot: deploy initiated id=fr-176222 type=percent-rollout target=10% regions=[na-west,eu-central]
Liam: watching embed latency dashboards. setting up temporary dashboard panel.
Priya: canary traffic looks fine in eu-central so far. na-west 95p for embeddings jumped from 45ms -> 160ms in first 6m.
SRE-Oncall: flagged. pulling traces for na-west pods. Any 5xxs?
Priya: no 5xxs, just higher tail latency and increased adapter cold-start times on new warm nodes.
Maya: ok pause na-west only and keep eu-central progressing. Command: ``/deploy pause fr-176222 --region na-west``
DeployBot: acknowledged: paused fr-176222 for region na-west. rollout status: na-west=0%, eu-central=10% -> global~5%
Liam: confirmed traffic shift. na-west pinned to v2026.03.22-stable.
SRE-Oncall: traces show high KV miss rate during model handoff. Recommend temporary PREFETCH=2 and running quick warmup for na-west.
Maya: agree. OpsLead will you run warmup + set PREFETCH?
OpsLead: on it. running: ``infra/warmup --region na-west --model rc6 --prefetch 2``
DeployBot: warmup job started job=warmup-176222-nw
OpsLead: warmup done, PREFETCH=2 set. KV hit ratio improved 0.38 -> 0.88.
Liam: nice. any objections to resuming na-west at a conservative ramp 1%->10% over 10m?
Priya: suggest 1%->3%->10% steps with 3m intervals. Safer for customer-facing tails.
Maya: let's do Priya's plan. Command: ``/deploy resume fr-176222 --region na-west --ramp 1,3,10 --interval 3m``
DeployBot: resuming fr-176222: na-west ramp=1%->3%->10% intervals=3m; eu-central remains at 10%
SRE-Oncall: added temporary alerting on na-west kv-miss-rate and embedding-95p. Monitoring now.
Liam: na-west at 1%: 95p back to 70ms.
Priya: at 3% stable. no errors.
Maya: at 10% na-west. Good. keeping rollout pin available for 45m for safety.
OpsLead: updating changelog: "rc6: PREFETCH=2 warmup to reduce adapter cold starts; temporary flag enabled for na-west."
DeployBot: rollout complete fr-176222 -> 10% active. To rollback: ``/deploy rollback fr-176222``
Liam: LGTM. I'll watch for 45m and then remove temp alerts if stable.
SRE-Oncall: thanks team. marking incident channel if anything outside thresholds."
